nom: Olay Retinol Night Cream for Women

avis.titre: Another Tried and True Olay Product
avis.texte: I've been using Oil of Olay since I was in my 20s and the only cream they had was the thin pink in the bottle with the sketch of an Indian woman as their "logo". I've been faithful to Olay because it has been faithful to me! I love that even their most expensive product is in the 30 - 40 dollar range and, yet, it works as well (if not better) than many much more expensive "beauty" products. I use "the red jar" in the morning and this "purple jar" at night. I have always had skin that breaks out easily (I was never able to use foundations and the like as I'd break out as if I was back in high school), and this has never given me any problem. A testament to Olay is that I was in the restroom at work one day and rinsed my face as it was hot and the A/C had broken. A young girl asked me what kind of foundation I used that I could "wash" and it didn't come right off. Her jaw dropped when I told her I didn't wear foundation. She couldn't believe that skin could look that good in "someone your age"! (Ahhhh, youth....ya gotta love 'em!) It goes on easily, is not greasy, and doesn't feel heavy....like you've left something on your face. I wake up and my skin feels soft and ready for a new day. It keeps your skin looking young and helps to eliminate the crows feet and worry lines. You have to love and appreciate a product that does what it says without emptying your pockets!

avis.titre: Olay Regenerist Retinol 24 Hour Night Moisturizer
avis.texte: The Olay Regenerist Retinol 24 Hour Night Moisturizer is highly rated by me for it’s gentle, hydrating formula that combines retinol with niacinamide. Priced around $30 to $40, it’s praised by me for reducing fine lines, evening skin tone, and delivering noticeable glow without the typical dryness or irritation associated with retinol. While results vary, I noticed softer texture and increased radiance within 2 weeks, with firmer skin and diminished fine lines after 28 days of regular use. The formula is completely fragrance-free and dye-free, which is excellent for sensitive skin. It is non-greasy, lightweight and absorbs in seconds.

“I’ve been using this cream for several weeks and I really love it. My skin feels softer, smoother, and more hydrated every morning. It doesn’t feel greasy or heavy, and it has helped improve the appearance of fine lines and tired-looking skin. A little goes a long way, so the jar lasts a long time.”

The cream feels very smooth. Fragrance free. And compatible with all skin types. Very moisturizing and I feel though the tub is small for the quantity you get. It will last a long time. It takes only a little bit to go a long way. Good value for money spent. I love it!!

avis.titre: My face feels like Silk; Feels soft and smooth!
avis.texte: I'm 56 years of age, but I've been TOLD that I look like I am in my L8 30s or early 40s. I take good care of my skin, I don't use anything but sunscreen and Oil of Olay products. I have other moisturizer products, but they don't feel like silk when administered. Leaves my face, cool, calm, and like silk (smooth) Thanks!
Love my night, cream. It’s not greasy it doesn’t smear on your pillowcase and it is very hydrating for your skin at night.
Excelente crema, me a gustado mucho, desde el inicio se siente una piel más suave creo que aún con más tiempo de uso puede dejar muy buenos recuerdos.

La crema es una joyaaaaaa, no tengo dudas de eso solo 3 veces a la semana y te va genial, lo único que si tengo que decir que tiene tache es que dice que te manda un regalo y eso es mentira no llega nada mas que la crema así que no se fien.

I found a note in the product box explaining the person was returning this product after 2 weeks of use because it burned their face. I did not order a used face cream that someone else stuck their finger in to apply to their face. I am returning this order back to Amazon.

Most evenings I use this after washing my face and stick with about the same amount each time. I smooth it over my cheeks first, then across my forehead, and whatever is left goes around my chin. One scoop has been enough, so I don't usually dip back into the jar while I'm putting it on. It spreads without much effort and settles in before I head to bed, so I don't feel like I'm waiting around for it. I also like that it's fragrance free because it doesn't stand out next to the other products I use in the evening. I've kept using it the same way instead of changing the amount from night to night. The jar still has plenty left since I'm only taking a small scoop each time, and that's pretty much how I've continued using it.

avis.titre: It takes a while to see noticeable results, but it seems to help.
avis.texte: I am 76 years old, and like most women try to prevent or remedy the signs of aging - especially on my face. Let's face, no facial cream is going to work miracles. Keeping your face moisturized, diet, and even heredity are all factors that affect your aging. In addition, the use of any facial cream is not going to show any improvement overnight. Prior to writing this review, I have used this facial cream for over 3 months before for I go to bed. I use a different cream for the daytime since this cream is heavier. So, what do I like about this facial cream? 1) Although it is thicker than my daytime cream, it absorbs well without having to rub it in. 2) It has little to no scent. 3) It seems to have reduced wrinkles I had a few months ago. I have added picture of my mother at 98 and also pictures of myself from a couple years ago and current. In choosing a facial cream, it is kind of a pig and a poke. Some work and some are a total waste of money and time. You just need to find one you are comfortable with and then give it at least 3 months or more to see any possible results. Personally, I like this as a night cream, and have seen some results. I do recommend this as a night cream, but you may not have the same results I have seen. As mentioned previously, diet and heredity are also factors. I hope this review was helpful for you.

avis.auteur: Súper rico, muy bueno para un regalo
avis.texte: Lo mejor de lo mejor Combinados con otras cremas faciales para uso diario dan un resultado impresionante Estoy súper feliz porque en tan solo un mes he visto el cambio de en mi rostro

avis.titre: Didn't work; not for near the eyes
avis.texte: Thought I would try this for my hyperpigmentation. I used it for over 2 weeks and saw zero difference (I know it says 4 weeks, but surely I would see something when past the halfway point). The color of my hyperpigmentation was just as dark. Additionally, because the product photos showed improvement in the woman's eye-area wrinkles, I decided to put some Olay closer to the corners of my eyes after the first week. That was a HUGE MISTAKE. A day or two in, I put some sunscreen near my eyes (as normal) and OMG the stinging, burning pain! Two hours later, washed my face with my usual gentle cleanser and the pain returned. Disregard the product photos: this should not be used near your eyes. (Issue resolved when I discontinued use there). Now, this is a nice night cream: pleasant fragrance and does a good job moisturizing. A little goes a long way too: I definitely need to use less than my regular moisturizer because it's thick. So it's a good quantity for the price: it will last a long time. Oh, and if you have mid-century bathroom fixtures (sink edge, toilet back) this glass jar is definitely going to crash onto your floor. The bottom of the jar is slick and not compatible with gently sloping surfaces. Maybe Olay Retinol works for others, but it is not for me.

I NEVER leave reviews, but I’m making an exception for this. I was wary of spending this much money on a moisturizer, but the reviews and the coupon got me to try it. I’m so glad I did! I was diagnosed with Rosacea in February, and was using a prescription ($500 ointment). I saw some improvement but not what I was hoping for. I started using this Regenerist Max, at night (in addition to my prescription in the morning) and in less than a week my skin looks substantially better. I also notice fewer lines, and my scars from having pre-cancerous lesions removed are substantially faded. I read where another reviewer had used this to treat a burn scar and, since I had a large burn on my forearm (2nd degree) that was fairly pronounced, I decided it was worth trying. In 48 hours it’s 90% healed! I plan to buy more regenerist products in the future because of these results
Este producto lo compré por una recomendación, espero funcione bien para mi cuidado del cutis
I love this face cream!! However my order arrived opened and exploded in the box, which was a total bummer.

avis.titre: Another Outstanding Olay Product After 20 Years of Use
avis.texte: I’ve been using Olay products for over 20 years, and this Olay Regenerist Retinol Night Cream MAX absolutely lives up to the Olay name. The brand has consistently delivered quality skincare, and this moisturizer is another excellent addition to my nighttime routine. The cream has a rich, luxurious texture that feels nourishing without being heavy or greasy. It absorbs quickly into the skin and leaves my face feeling soft, smooth, and well hydrated. I especially appreciate that it is fragrance-free, making it comfortable to use every night without any overpowering scent. This formula combines Pro-Retinol, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), and Triple Collagen Peptide, creating a powerful anti-aging moisturizer designed to help improve the appearance of wrinkles, fine lines, uneven texture, and dullness. The added hydration helps balance the retinol, making it feel gentler than some retinol products I’ve tried in the past. After several weeks of use, my skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and appears more refreshed in the morning. I have noticed improved softness and a more even-looking complexion. The cream provides excellent overnight hydration without leaving a sticky residue on my pillow or skin. The 2.6-ounce jar is generously sized, and a little product goes a long way. The packaging feels premium, and the quality of the ingredients is evident from the first application. If you’ve used Olay products before, you’ll likely appreciate the thoughtful formulation and performance of th

I’ve really been enjoying this night cream. It’s fragrance-free, absorbs well, and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated without feeling greasy. The formula is gentle enough for regular use and hasn’t irritated my skin. The large size lasts a long time, making it a great value

avis.titre: Gentle, comfortable on the skin, and effective
avis.texte: Olay products are always dependable but I really love this MAX Retinol Night Cream. I haven't been using it for long enough to speak definitively about its long-term effects but I can say that it glides on and absorbs well and, for me, causes absolutely no skin irritation. The texture of the cream is intriguing. It feels like it is slightly elastic and it provides a durable protective barrier overnight. If I swipe my fingers across my skin after wearing it for a while, I do get a little pilling, but its not the kind of dry pilling I get from other moisturizers. It leaves a moist and elastic residue on my fingers, which reassures me that it is continuing to deliver moisturizing protection hours after application. Basically, I should just keep my fingers away from my face and let it do its job! It's a really easy and comfortable way to deliver a does of retinol and peptides to my skin.

I have used Olay for years! My face wash, toner, moisturizer and body wash are all Olay. I haven’t used any of their night cream before, so I was very excited to try this. This moisturizer is fragrance free and has a good consistency, not too thick and not greasy at all. After washing my face at night, this goes on my face and neck. I only need a small amount and it goes a long way. I love that as it dries, it slightly feels like a powder and again, not greasy at all. I’ve been using it for about two weeks and my skin does r look dull in the morning. It has a nice fresh glow to it. Im very pleased with it!

avis.titre: Gentle, makes my skin feel soft and smooth
avis.texte: This night cream is incredibly moisturizing and makes my skin feel so soft. The first night I used it, I decided to do a patch test first and only applied it to my neck. The cream is fragrance-free and feels very gentle, and I had no irritation at all. The next night, I applied it to my entire face and neck area, by applying it in an upward circular motion. My skin absorbed it quickly and felt instantly hydrated, and there wasn’t any greasiness at all. I can’t overstate how soft and smooth my skin feels afterwards. I’m really impressed. It’s very gentle and caused no issues to my sensitive skin. It’s a larger 2.6 oz jar, so I think it’s a great value. I highly recommend it!

This Olay Retinol Night Cream is definitely worth the price. It feels just as luxurious as the more expensive high end brands. It may seem pricey but if you consider how expensive the high end brands are, this one is more reasonably priced. I love the great ingredients, retinol, collagen peptides and niacinamide, so beneficial for your skin. This cream has a very creamy, luxurious feel to it. It does not have any scent so it’s great for those sensitive to smells. You don’t need a lot as it spreads easily over your skin and you do get a good sized jar (so it should last a while). The cream soaks nicely into your skin and doesn’t leave any greasiness behind. I didn’t have any irritation with this cream and I do tend to have sensitive skin. My face feels incredibly soft after using and I feel my fine lines appear a little smoother. Of course you need to use any face products for 8-12 weeks to see if there’s more noticeable results but so far I’m liking what I see!

avis.titre: Trusted, High-Performance Nighttime formula from Oil of Olay
avis.texte: This Olay Retinol 24 MAX night cream delivers a highly effective formula from a brand you can completely trust for consistent results. Sourced in a larger 2.6oz supply, it provides a generous amount before needing a replacement, making it a highly efficient asset for a daily skincare. The combination of Max-strength Retinol and Niacinamide works cleanly overnight to target deeper wrinkles and hyperpigmentation without any greasy residue or synthetic fragrances. It is a straightforward, reliable treatment that executes exactly as promised to optimize skin resilience. Completely happy and results come over time as expected. A great deal!

This skin cream is amazing! Fragrance free. It seriously only takes a very small amount to cover your entire face and neck. After applying it, my face feels so soft! I have been using Olay products forever now and I absolutely love this addition! So very easy to use. It's quite a large container of cream so it will last me a while. Definitely satisfied with purchase and highly recommend!
I have been using Olay regenerist for many years. After opening a new jar, last week, my face has been burning and itching with swollen eyes as well. I know something in the formulation has changed.

I really like this Olay retinol night cream. I have never liked the scented Olay products, so I'm glad this is fragrance-free. When I wake up in the morning I feel my face, and it feels smooth. It is also not sticky, which is great because I'm not a fan of sticky creams. This is a pretty large jar of cream at 2.6 ounces. It may be kind of pricey for Oil of Olay but this is a good sized quality product.

I'm giving a 1 star because of the condition I received this product. Upon unwrapping this product, the outer wrapping, the box, and the outside of the jar were extremely oily; once I opened the jar, 3/4 of the content was missing. This product costs too much money only to receive 1/4 of the product.

There was no cap/lid on the jar, therefore produce wasn’t secure. Seems to be fair amount of lotion missing and packaging had product leaked inside. Package not suitable to even return this leaking jar of lotion.
I opened the box and the cap was not fully screwed on the bottle. When I took it off, it was apparent that the product got all messy. Not sure if this was already opened or used? Kinda gross.

avis.titre: If I could leave no stars I would leave no stars. My face burns and itches . I don’t have sensitive
avis.texte: I hate that it literally burnt the crap out of my face !! And I’m not sensitive to products at all ! I read a lot of reviews on google after this happened to my face and everyone complains of the same thing . Do Not Buy this product!
The description from the box is different from what is inside.
I don’t know what’s inside but I’ve got some serious rash after using it.
Came like it was already been used. Real thick not like other olay products

I ordered the Olay Regenerist Retinol 24 Max Moisturizer, Retinol 24 Max Night Face Cream, 1.7 Oz + Whip Face Moisturizer Trial Size Gift Set. I actually ended up liking the Whip Moisturizer a lot more than the Olay Regenerist Retinol Moisturizer. Both products are pretty much unscented. Personally, I prefer to have a scent because unscented products tend to smell rubbery or chemically (just like the container or the ingredients in them.) This stuff doesn't have any really pleasant smell or application. It is a very no-nonsense product. The Olay Regenerist is a very thin cream, and a tiny little bit goes a long way. This jar will last quite some time (probably at least 6 months for me, but I have very oily skin and don't need a ton of moisture except in the winter or if I've gotten a sunburn.) The formula itself is smooth and very very mildly greasy or oily. I honestly didn't find it that oily/greasy at all, until I tried the whipped sample, which applies and becomes basically matte with a dry sort of a finish. The contrast made me realize that the Olay Regenerist has a bit more of a slippery or dewy finish. Personally, I prefer the whipped sample. It created a nice moisture barrier on my skin, while leaving my naturally oily skin with a more of a dry or matte finish to it. It felt incredibly lightweight, and not at all like I'd put on layers of product. I haven't really noticed much of a change in my overall skin tone, although my skin does feel smooth and soft in the areas

avis.titre: Best night cream on the market
avis.texte: This stuff is creamy gold. It has no scent which is great for a face cream. I’ve used these for years and it is always a consistent, thick great cream. It makes my 50 year old face have baby smooth skin. I’ll be a customer always for this product.

This moisturizes well, but I'm not sure how well it's working on my dark spots. I haven't been using this for too long, but I'm hoping it can fade my dark spots slightly. My dark spots are on my cheeks, but they're fairly light brown. I'm hoping since my spots are not too dark, that this cream will help fade them somewhat. It should for the price. Tip: Don't forget that if you're using a Retinol cream/serum, that it's important to use a daily sunscreen because the sun can actually be worse on retinol treated skin and cause discoloration. This cream applies easily and moisturizes well. It didn't leave too much of a greasy residue feeling behind. It gets applied at night, before bed, so any residue gets washed off in the morning anyways. Overall this is pricey and hopefully it will work. I'll update later if it doesn't.

I've been using this for a couple weeks now and I really like a few things about it. I like that it's truly fragrance free, which is really nice. It is really smooth and goes on so nice, it feels really clean and thick. The only complaint I have is that I have a few places on my face that are prone to dry skin and I don't see that making any difference on those areas. I can tell it's keeping the rest of my face moisturized, but stops short at that. This is, admittedly, a fraction of the price of other moisturizers I typically use so I do think this is a good option in this price range. If you have really dry skin, you might want to look for something else to use in addition to this product.

avis.titre: Olay a trusted brand for me!
avis.texte: Olay is a trusted name in skin care products and one that I have used for years. I've been using the Olay regenerist whip and I really like it! It goes on light without feeling Gracie. It moisturizes my skin well overnight or in the morning before makeup. I love the small travel/trial size pouch for when I travel! The regenerist retinol 24 Max is truly fragrance-free, also goes on the light and hydrates my skin overnight. My skin looks brighter and better in the morning even though we're going into the deep dark days of winter 😅 Olay for the win with another quality product 👍

To start this off, my skin type is oily，prone to closed comedones and some acne. This olay moisturizer claims to hydrate skin for 24 hours, visible improvements in fine lines wrinkles, smoothness, brightness, forming, dark spots, and pores. I was really excited when I found out that Olay had created a new retinol 24 line. Overall very satisfied with this product，But I need a longer time to feel the changes it brings to my skin!

avis.titre: Pleasantly Surprised With The Fast Results!
avis.texte: "Olay Regenerist Retinol 24 Max Moisturizer, Retinol 24 Max Night Face Cream, 1.7 Oz + Whip Face Moisturizer Travel/Trial Size Gift Set" I have to admit I've let my skin care regime go to hell during COVID ... so I'm trying to get back into the habit of taking care of *me*. I'm really pleasantly surprised with this. I did "Before" photos and just took some "After" photos 5 nights later, and the photos speak for themselves. I'm 59 so I know that I can't totally erase the wrinkles but this cream really did help to reduce the lines by about 25% or so. Can't beat that. There's minimal to no scent and both products are absorbed quickly by the skin.. and a little goes a long way, Definitely 5 stars for this one!

I love using retinol products now that I am in my 40’s, and this inexpensive product delivers. It works so well, I actually love washing my face at night just to put this on. At first, my skin did get irritated in spots and peeled, but that went away after about a week. My skins texture and redness have markedly changed, and I really love the smell and feel of this product. I signed up for the subscribe and save to get a discounted price and had planned to cancel, but now I am going to continue with this product! It is the perfect night time moisturizer for my face.

I love Olay. I’m 60 and have been using Olay since my 20’s. Before they had all of the serums. Back in the day it was the white bottle. You know what I mean. I use the regenerist line. I don’t use foundation. I use their tinted cream. I swear by this brand.

So I generally have a combination skin that shifts between dry and oily. What I really love about this cream so far is that it's perfect for night time. It is on the heavier side when it comes to thickness but does apply to my skin well. I've been using it the last few weeks have have seen some of the deeper lines that use to be on my forehead look smaller and more filled in. I'd highly recommend this for individuals with dryer skin who need hydration.

SHOCKING results: I’ve never had a skin reaction to any cream before, but look at this horrible Retinol Burn this cream caused on my neck. I don’t have sensitive skin, but obviously this cream was way too intense for me. Please be careful in using this cream. I wish I had done a small patch test before I applied to my whole neck area. Take this cream off my list!!!

avis.titre: Painful burning itching face and neck after only 3 uses
avis.texte: I would not recommend this product to anyone but I’d you want to try it put it on a small spot somewhere unnoticeable for a few days first. I developed a horribly painful itching burning rash on my face and neck. I used the product 3 times and this picture was taken 4 days after I quit using it and 2 days after I started using a prescription cream from my doctor to treat the damage. It was a lot worse than this.

An absolutely outstanding product!!! Myself 48 years old and my oldest daughter 28 years old both have been using this and we both noticed the subtle ranges of its potential and awesomeness of results..leaves face so soft and smooth ( no greasy film or dryness) we absolutely love this product and even bought some for family for Christmas gifts!!. Myself M after 3 days using i immediately could see my tone, firming highlights and the lil wrinkles with old age lines going away and skin smooth and firming! Thank you..we will continue using this and all olay products as we have over 30 years from bathwash, soaps and moisturizers...Kudos to Olay manufacturers;) God bless and stay safe .. sincerely. Cindy Casey & Jamie Shoemaker BSN in Nursing my colleague's are even starting to use olay products especially this one !! ...STAY BEAUTIFUL AND ALWAYS SAFE ❤

The product had stickers on it that were removed by someone. I question where it came from originally. It’s in the product box that is intact. I’m torn on if it’s a returned item or even an Olay product?
I love this product. It brings back memories grin my childhood. Can't go wrong with Oil of Olay.

I am a 58 year old female with melesma for over 20 years and for the first time after using this cream within 3 days I can see and feel the difference in my skin texture and look.its softer and and brighter and appear to be firmer will continue to use this for the next 6 months to get the reL benefits. Love love love this ❣❣❣❣❣💞💞💞💯
Love this stuff! Satin skin! I'm 46yrs old almost 47. Not too greasy, doesn't clog pores. I have hardly ANY lines on my face. No scent to light.
Can really feel it toning my skin. My wrinkles and deep lines are much less noticeable! The retinol does dry your skin out at first, but your skin will get use to it and even out.

avis.titre: I think it is effective. But I don’t like the filmy feeling left on my sink.
avis.texte: Since Olay is a big brand so I trust the formulation of this product, and as an experienced retinol user of about more than 4 years, I wanted to share my experience. I have previously used and loved Retinol products from CeraVe (purple packaging), Neutrogena Retinol Pro+, and Kiehl's Retinol Skin-Renewing. Because I have dry skin, I introduced those gently and never experienced severe redness or peeling. However, because those formulas are likely on the milder side, my feel my skin’s improvement eventually becomes less noticeable. Curiosity led me to try Olay Max to see if a stronger formula would give me better results. The Performance: I have been using this every other night for about 10 days, following it up with a basic, well-known Kiehl's moisturizer. I can definitely tell it is working differently than my previous products: Application: There is a very slight tingling feeling when first apply, but it isn't uncomfortable. It absorbs quickly and feels hydrating. Love the fragrance free cream. Next-Day Results: The next morning, my skin feels slightly rough (which I think is the cell turnover) and my cheeks show a very mild redness. Because this is a "Max" formula, it is noticeably stronger than what I'm used to, but I view these signs as positive proof that the product is effective. The Downside/ Texture: The only reason I am giving this 4 stars instead of 5 is the feeling after apply. Like many other Olay products, it leaves a silky, film-like feeling on the skin after

I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and I’m prone to cystic acne, so I patch test just about everything before it goes on my face. I also started introducing this slowly since it contains a higher amount of retinol, and I’m really glad I did because I absolutely love it. I only use it at night and wouldn’t recommend wearing it before sun exposure or on sunburned skin since retinol can make your skin more sensitive. I apply it after my milky toner, and it layers really well. The cream is thick and very moisturizing without feeling greasy or clogging my pores. It has no added fragrance, which is a huge plus for sensitive skin, and it’s done a great job keeping my skin hydrated. You also get a generous amount of product, so the jar lasts a long time. Overall, I think it’s a great value for the money. If you have dry, sensitive skin and are looking for a fragrance-free retinol moisturizer, this has been a great addition to my skincare routine. My only wish is that it would come with an applicator bc I don’t want to be sticking dirty or fully sterile hands into a product that I’ll be applying to my face. I ended up buying a skincare spatula to apply to keep fingers out of it.

avis.titre: Love it! Can Safely Use Nightly!
avis.texte: I love how I can use this retinol nightly without skin irritation or chemical reactions like other retinol products I've tried. This leaves my face and neck feeling hydrated and healthy. I'm 31, but already see a huge difference. The results speak for themselves for this one! I am going to stick with Olay skin care products. NOTE: I went from having a skincare routine of cheaper and random drugstore products (CeraVe face lotions, Aveeno cleanser, Garnier toner/cleanser, Neutrogena sunscreen) everyday to all the products in the last picture. I will also be reviewing those as well since it is a routine that caused the difference, not just one product.
